podcast.title: Gabber Derivative Post-Decline
podcast.body: After Gabber's decline around 2000, the genre largely ceased to be played at major festivals. It was succeeded by derivative styles such as Hardstyle, which incorporated elements of Gabber's intensity in a new form. "el género dejó de sonar en fiestivales a favor de estilos derivados, como Hartstein o el tráncemas duro."
